key_findings: Diclofenac-quinazoline compounds 12 and 16 reduced MyD88, serum COX-2 and PGE2 and produced antinociception in cisplatin/radiation-induced neuropathy.
Docking showed high affinity of the compounds for the COX-2 active site.
